_comment: Reference list of the MCP servers this team uses. Claude Code does NOT read this file — register them once per person at user scope so no token or per-clone config lives in the tree: claude mcp add -s user --transport http <name> <url>. The repo's own .mcp.json holds only laravel-boost, which is project-scoped by nature because it shells into the dev container.

cloudflare._comment: DNS + the rest of the Cloudflare API for codegeek.ir. OAuth per person, no shared token.
